notes.title: New Map - "Workers Town"
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/e999ca1df6b606206eac13c388756245e2efc25e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Map — Workers Town[/b][/p][p][i]Workers Town[/i] is a small settlement that must be assaulted from nearby trenches. The center of the map is the key battleground. You can reach it by vehicle. Ammunition is available only at capture points. The map is available in all game modes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][p]Upon receiving critical damage, you now have 15 seconds before bleeding out. When the timer expires, the kill will be credited to the player who last damaged you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Map Editor News[/b][/p][p]No changes have been made. The map filtering issue remains unresolved. If nothing changes, we will likely release the map editor without moderation in September.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's Next?[/b][/p][p]We are working on a new map featuring a large industrial area.[/p]

notes.title: New map: "Frontier Village"
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/afd6fbfb1f716e22845ab486f20819537970108b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]New Map — "Frontier Village"[/b][/p][p]Introducing a new map — "Frontier Village" — where intense battles unfold in a semi-abandoned village surrounded by marshlands. Key objectives are located close to each other: the outskirts, village center, garages, and industrial zone. The map is available in all game modes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][p]You can now switch teams. Switching is allowed once per minute. When switching teams, your character will die, and the previous team will lose 1 reinforcement point.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][p]No Signal screen: drones no longer bounce like a ball upon collision. Instead, the connection is correctly lost and the No Signal screen is displayed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Map Editor News[/b][/p][p]The basic version of the map editor is ready. However, its release is temporarily delayed — the game currently lacks filtering for unapproved maps, which may appear in multiplayer. We’ve contacted Steam Support and are waiting for a solution.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s next?[/b][/p][p]Let us know which map you’d like to see next — we read every message and value your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.5.2500 — Fixes & Changes
notes.content: [p][b]Fixes & Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused drones to randomly disappear during flight.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shooting through walls while in third-person view.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced how often characters get stuck on spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where dropping a VOG could disconnect you from the Stryker.[/p][/*][*][p]All maps once again receive purely artistic names.[/p][/*][*][p]The score table can now be opened while in a vehicle or in flight.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed vehicle collisions so the driver no longer dies on exit.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased zoom when aiming in third-person view.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor improvements and fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.2439 – ATV, Finishing Moves, and Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/e198adbbec680564266125d0c2f825b720aaa78b.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added a new vehicle — the ATV, designed for two soldiers.
[*] The passenger can shoot while riding, but be careful not to accidentally take out your driver.
[*] Downed state introduced. When a player takes heavy damage, they fall to the ground and can only crawl toward teammates, hoping to be revived. Any player can revive any other player an unlimited number of times.
[*] Improved in-vehicle animations and exit point selection logic. Drivers now properly hold the handlebars, and character poses inside vehicles are correctly aligned with their assigned seats.
[*] Suspension tuned for all vehicles to improve handling and movement across rough terrain.
[*] Explosion physics adjusted per ammo type based on the explosive power of each projectile.
[*] Increased assault rifle fire rate.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused drones to randomly disappear — or at least we really hope we did.
[*] A lot of work has been done on the Map Editor integration, which will be released in the coming days (or maybe weeks).
[*] Minor fixes and small improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.2191: Chernogorsk, Singleplayer Missions, and a New Ammunition Type
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/b132db9ae81eb7b1741142c3f14937fcaa41c7e2.jpg[/img]
[b]New Map – Chernogorsk[/b]
Urban combat in dense city environments. The map is available in all game modes.

[b]What’s New[/b]
[list]
[*] Singleplayer Missions: Three multiplayer maps are now available in solo mode, including Chernogorsk. Your task is to locate and eliminate enemy infantry.
[*] New Homemade Ammunition IEDW1: An improvised projectile more powerful than the PG7VS, effective against vehicles and infantry. Available in missions and multiplayer (in blue crates).
[*] Weather and Time of Day: Choose weather conditions in both singleplayer and multiplayer. Get ready for rain, sunshine, or fog.
[*] Sensitivity and Inversion Settings: Added for operator and vehicles using keyboard controls.
[*] The Host Can Now Kick Players via the Scoreboard.
[*] Other Improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/0c6be00c506ce133b002b91483a12cc3f5d2adb7.jpg[/img]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Player now spawns correctly – no more falling through the map
[*] Fixed double detonation of explosives
[*] Proper grenade detonation on drones
[*] Striker no longer disappears when dropping ammo
[*] Striker now takes damage from its own shells
[*] Fixed bullet impact effects on certain surfaces
[*] Disabled inventory switching after death
[*] Fixed abrupt camera angle change on the Striker when control is lost
[*] Removed pistol from character visuals
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

[b]Plans[/b]
[list]
[*] The map editor is in active development. Core functionality is already working and integrated with Steam Workshop.
[*] Work ahead includes expanding the asset library for convenient map building.
[*] Development of tools for AI setup – paths, objectives, actions. Everything needed to create full-fledged singleplayer missions directly in the editor.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.1909 – Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Fixed:
[list]
[*] Now you can scroll through the server list
[*] The drone is now destroyed with a single bullet
[*] The soldier’s camera angle no longer resets when exiting a vehicle
[*] Fixed a bug where players would get stuck in mid-air after a vehicle explosion
[*] Bot soldiers no longer disappear after death
[*] The boat can now move backward
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed looting two drones with a fast click if only one remained in the crate
[*] When spawning a Stryker, its camera now always faces forward regardless of the operator’s view
[*] Fixed a vehicle sound issue where it was audible everywhere regardless of distance
[*] The item pickup animation works again. Added a new animation when holding a rifle
[*] Fixed a bug where the drone remained in the inventory when switching items during a throw
[*] Upon detonation, the drone no longer knocks players back but instead creates interference
[*] Soldiers no longer fly into the sky or teleport upon colliding with a drone
[*] When quickly switching network types in the server list, results now display correctly
[*] Adjusted the volume of the Stryker – it is now easier to hear
[*] Reduced the push force of soldiers – they can no longer move trucks or other vehicles
[*] Fixed the "Team Deathmatch" text that extended beyond the UI boundaries
[*] Removed repeated damage triggers for vehicles – now the engine sound simply turns off
[*] Bot soldiers and vehicles now appear in the kill feed with a neutral white color
[*] On the "Trench Wasteland" map, thermal vision now works correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where the mission with the APC would not end
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added a check for getting stuck when exiting a vehicle
[*] Soldiers can now be run over and killed by vehicles
[*] Improved hit registration for weapons
[*] Added quick drone launch (activates regardless of inventory selection) on a separate Q key to prevent conflicts with weapon reloading
[*] Vehicles now respawn at their designated locations at the start of each round
[*] A loading screen is now displayed when creating or joining a server to prevent double clicks
[*] The interface is now adapted for different screen formats
[*] Vehicles now get destroyed if left unused for more than 90 seconds
[*] The kill feed now shows who destroyed a vehicle and all passengers inside when it explodes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.1847 — New Map, Vehicles, Weapons & Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]New Map – Pacific Rim[/h2]

[previewyoutube=OeqlcKtzlxE;full][/previewyoutube]

Battles now take place among islands, and players can travel between them using boats. A boat can hold two players, but nothing stops you from jumping on top—just don't expect it to always float properly and take you where you need to go.

[h2]Weapons & Balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added the AK-12 automatic rifle. Ammo is not replenished yet, and each player has three magazines.
[*] Server settings now allow disabling all weapons or limiting combat to knives only.
[*] Inventory is now limited to three slots. Drones no longer stack—you can no longer carry three FPV and three strike drones at the same time.
[/list]

[h2]Experimental Vehicles[/h2]

A UAZ has been added to the Trenches Wasteland map for fast travel between points. If the vehicle proves popular, we will refine it and add more in the next update.

[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reworked FPV drone sounds.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented configuring the controller for the operator.
[*] Added official dedicated servers. They are currently in test mode and may be unavailable at times. The main game mode remains P2P.
[*] Added a new cooperative map: "Silent Waters: Boat Operation".
[*] All multiplayer maps now support all game modes.
[*] Completely reworked weapon handling animations, resulting in a visual update for soldiers.
[*] When creating a server, you can now select multiple maps, which will rotate at the end of each match.
[*] Added a first-person view for soldiers.
[*] Improved bot aiming and shooting mechanics against drones.
[*] Soldiers now use active ragdolls that react to drone impacts. Previously, a death animation played first, keeping soldiers in place.
[*] Various minor fixes that we've already forgotten about.
[/list]

[h2]In the next update, we plan to:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Focus more on single-player missions.
[*] Introduce AI-controlled vehicles.
[*] Add all single-player mission maps to cooperative mode.
[/list]

Thank you for playing. Your feedback helps make the game better.

notes.title: Improved Support for DJI FPV Remote Controller and TBS Tango
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/9d1c1930b2f3d1e3ec10d07c51681a0b8aa474e9.jpg[/img]

We received the DJI FPV Remote Controller 3 and TBS Tango 2 V4 for testing. Initially, flying drones with these controllers was almost impossible — the button and axis mappings were so mixed up that it made gameplay extremely difficult. The main issue, however, was the lack of an option to remove button and axis bindings from actions in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/eaa79e6b415d3b7950ef4a7063c12ed02d918413.jpg[/img]

We've now added this functionality, along with a convenient feature to remove all bindings in bulk. As a result, configuring these controllers has become much easier, making flying a much more enjoyable experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/aedddaa0f2e2c98e994e351631514abf0145435f.jpg[/img]

Important: Resetting and removing bindings applies only to the currently selected drone or operator and does not affect other configurations.

notes.title: Fix for Occupied Slots After Players Leave the Session
notes.content: We have fixed an issue where slots in the game remained occupied even after players left the session. Now, when a player leaves, the slot is properly freed up, allowing new participants to join the game without any issues.

notes.title: New Conquest mode with the new map Trench Wasteland
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/1d748af74b0f99082d8ab333cf452f033b6fce45.jpg[/img]
[h3]Conquest Mode[/h3]
In this mode, to win, you need to capture and hold the majority of control points, preventing enemy penetration and stopping their assault attempts.

[h3]Trench Wasteland Map[/h3]
This map is specially designed for the new mode and features 5 capture points. There are vast open fields between the points, so you'll need to cover some distance, which is quite dangerous as drones circle overhead.

[h3]Chat[/h3]
In multiplayer (except for co-op), voice and text chats have been introduced — both general and team chat.
For the scout class, only team voice chat is available.
To mute a player, open the scoreboard, right-click, hover over the player’s name, and click on the speaker icon.
To mute all players, set the voice chat volume to 0 in the audio settings.

Control Buttons:
[b]B (D-Pad Left)[/b] — Team Voice Chat
[b]V (D-Pad Right)[/b] — General Voice Chat
[b]Y[/b] — Team Text Chat
[b]U[/b] — General Text Chat
To hide the text chat, you can use the hotkey [b]T[/b] or disable it in the gameplay settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/165fabc82a8cf8b72d0cddbbd23f8bfd045ecb81.jpg[/img]
[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*] Strike drone crates with VOG grenades have been added, but there are not many of them, so you'll need to search. You can carry up to 3 FPV drones and 3 strike drones at the same time. Use the mouse wheel (or LB, RB on a gamepad) to switch between drones.
[*] The active section is now highlighted in the game settings.
[*] It's now possible to disable controller support for soldiers and drones. In this case, a regular gamepad will be used if connected.
[*] A new Graphics Settings option has been added to the video settings for bulk adjustments.
[*] You can now reset the control settings for each type of drone separately without affecting other control settings.
[*] The enemy soldiers' weapon spread has been increased.
[*] The session browser has been improved for better gamepad navigation and now displays more server settings.
[*] The glasses animation has been fixed, and they now fit the face properly.
[*] The character's movement speed has been reduced while aiming down sights (ADS).
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer in the Game. Update 0.3.1222.
notes.content:
The game now features multiplayer support for up to 10 players. You can now enjoy three game modes:

[list]
[*] Cooperative Mode – Three maps with infantry from single missions are available, where you and your friends will fight together.
[*] Elimination Mode – You have one life per round, and the team that eliminates all opponents first wins. The game starts with a minimum of 4 players.
[*] Team Deathmatch – Respawn as many times as you like, and victory goes to the team that reaches the set number of eliminations first. The game starts regardless of the number of participants.
[/list]

Multiplayer uses a P2P architecture, where the server is the player who created the session. If the host ends the game, the session ends for everyone. Your gameplay experience largely depends on the host's connection quality. Dedicated server support is planned for the future if the community shows interest in multiplayer.

In the online game, you will need to search for ammo in crates scattered around the map, which replenish every 30-60 seconds. The maximum number of FPV drones you can carry is three.

The Scout Drone can now move around the map. Visually, it still looks like a strike drone but is distinguished by a different sound. A new model will be added later. The scout also now has a thermal imager, available in both offline mode and multiplayer, with the option to disable it for hardcore gameplay. The scout's flight altitude is limited to avoid interfering with combat.

In single-player mode, there is no longer an explicit enemy count. Instead, you have a thermal imager, and the commander will notify you when all enemies have been eliminated.

The explosive system has been reworked to improve detonation reliability. Additional game optimization has also been done, which should significantly improve FPS.

Now, NPC soldiers behave more aggressively, opening fire with greater intensity and accuracy.

For convenience, all types of drones and the operator are now separated into tabs in the control settings, and each has its own axis settings. The names of all control buttons have also been changed for easier understanding. We recommend checking the controls before starting the game, especially for the drone operator.

Various old bugs have been fixed, but as is often the case, new bugs and issues may arise. We look forward to feedback from the gaming community to further improve the game.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 0.2.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/3bfece52032c121e721b675b4585986d994e7ee5.jpg[/img]

New Map "Airfield"
A new map has been added to the game, representing a military airfield. On the airfield, enemy planes are stationed and covered by anti-aircraft guns, making them difficult to destroy. Players are advised to first destroy the anti-aircraft guns or disable their operators using VOGs or grenades.

AI Soldier Behavior Changes
AI soldiers now have a better understanding of their environment and actively use cover for protection.

Other Changes
Main Menu: The mission list is now vertically aligned for convenience, and an additional confirmation window for loading has been added to prevent accidental loads.
Soldier Physics: Improved ragdoll physics after death.
Performance: Transition to a new engine version has improved performance due to multithreading support, but this is not guaranteed. Despite this, some related issues have been resolved. If you encounter any new problems or bugs, we welcome your feedback.

Future Plans
We continue to work on improving AI and optimizing gameplay based on player feedback. We read all comments, Discord messages, and emails. We strive to implement most suggestions into the game, but we cannot promise specific timelines.

notes.title: Update 0.2.2 - New map "Quiet Waters: Water Operation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/781d528a37ecd60b387ed1dba96ef224fe772a45.jpg[/img]

The new map "Quiet Waters: Water Operation" offers you to try yourself in the role of a drone operator in the challenging conditions of fog. You need to detect and destroy 10 enemy sabotage groups trying to cross the river in boats.

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Lighting has been adjusted, shadows are no longer pitch black
[*] Now, with strong interference, you can lose control of the drone
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Striker to collide with its own ammunition with its blades
[*] Now, to avoid collision, when launching a new drone, the previous one disappears if it is nearby
[*] Various minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 - Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/65872a8274dc206aca22c2ea2e7a03ad83972bb5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Map optimization has been conducted, ensuring higher loading speeds and an increase in FPS.
[*] A T72 tank moving along an asphalt road has been added to the first map.
[*] Localization errors have been corrected.
[*] The issue where the Striker UI overlapped the settings menu has been resolved.
[*] The scout's gaze direction at the map start has been corrected.
[*] The blast radius of the thermobaric munition has been reduced by 1.5 times.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
[h2]What's New:[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new type of drone, the "Striker," designed for dropping ammunition, has been introduced. Two types of ammunition are available for drops: grenade launcher rounds and hand grenades. The Striker is capable of carrying two grenade launcher rounds simultaneously.
[*] The kamikaze drone now has the option to choose from ammunition types. Three types of ammunition are now available: shaped charge, fragmentation, and thermobaric. Each type possesses unique damage characteristics and specific explosion effects, making the choice of projectile critically important for inflicting damage on infantry and equipment.
[*] A drone configuration feature has been added, allowing the selection of drone types and ammunition both from the main menu and directly during mission execution. Adjusting the camera's view angle and field of view (FOV) is now available in the drone settings section.
[/list]
[list]
[*] New detailed trenches have appeared on the game maps. 
[*] Biomes on all available maps of the eastern ridge have been reworked. 
[*] The "Infantry in Trenches" map has been enriched with a more branched network of trenches and an increased number of enemy infantry. 
[*] The "Sabotage Group" map has seen an increase in the size of the populated area and the number of personnel of the sabotage-reconnaissance group.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Models of soldiers and weapons have been replaced with more detailed ones.
[*] Rifle shooting has been introduced: now, when a drone enters the visibility or hearing range of soldiers, they will open fire with small arms. 
[*] Pipeline collision issues on the training map have been fixed, shaders for transparent materials have been readjusted for a more accurate rendering of smoke effects, and a system for simulating the impact wave affecting the environment has been added. 
[*] The sound characteristics of armored vehicles have also been improved.
[/list]

[h2]Notes:[/h2]

With the introduction of a new type of drone and a variety of ammunition, numerous changes have been made, previous errors have been corrected, and, likely, new ones have emerged. The Striker has a relatively arcade flight mode, as the flight controller was developed in just a few days. Currently, soldiers can run through walls and get stuck in trenches, and their shooting leaves much to be desired. Despite this, a solid foundation has been laid for further development of the game and the improvement of the artificial intelligence of soldiers and equipment. In the upcoming updates, we plan to focus on adding new maps and developing artificial intelligence.

notes.title: We are excited to share the latest development news
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/b3d6bba110b904d744384ea1692cc95f3cdae715.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] The kamikaze drone model is complete. It will be visible after an update that will add the functionality to select ammunition for attacks.
[*] Currently, we are developing a drone with a drop device, which will add new possibilities for strategy and tactics.
[*] We are actively working on improving the intelligence of soldiers, so that each new playthrough offers a new experience and is different from the previous one.
[*] Work continues on creating two new maps in the "Eastern Ridge" and "Middle East" regions.
[/list]
The approximate time for the completion of these current tasks is the end of January.

notes.title: Expanding Capabilities, Rectifying Shortcomings, and Our Plans
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] A frame rate limit option has been added to the graphics settings. Set the limit to 30-60 frames for the comfortable operation of your graphics card.
[*] A re-binding function for Roll and Pitch has been added to the keyboard layout.
[*] Issues with key remapping have been fixed.
[*] Errors in the display of bound buttons after resetting settings have been corrected.
[*] Collisions on the training map have been fixed; for example, it is now possible to fly through the cabin of a Kamaz truck.
[*] Soldiers in underwear and colorful weapons have been removed.
[*] The drone can now land without breaking, with damage only possible in case of collision with the blades. On the "Training" map, the start begins from the ground, while on other maps the start remains airborne.
[*] A tip has been added during auto-calibration about the necessity to set the sticks to the central position.
[*] In the gameplay settings, it's possible to change the angle and FOV of the camera, with changes applied to the next spawned drone.
[*] A sound effect has been added for the drone during Roll.
[/list]

Current Work:
[list]
[*] Work is ongoing on the artificial intelligence of soldiers, to make them react to the approach of a drone, flee, hide, and open fire.
[*] The "Aerodrome" map is being created in the "Eastern Ridge" region.
[*] Development of the first map in the "Middle East" region.
[*] Implementation of a new enemy skills system to create complex behavior scenarios.
[*] Creation of new drone models, including kamikaze drones and drones equipped with ammunition dropping devices.
[/list]

Our Plans:
[list]
[*] To develop a realistic artificial intelligence for the enemy.
[*] To add the ability to transport personnel on vehicles, which can disembark upon attack.
[*] To redesign existing maps in the "Eastern Ridge" region with new AI for soldiers and vehicles.
[*] Creation of maps in the "Middle East" region.
[*] Development of special operation maps with unique tasks.
[/list]

* Consideration is being given to clarifying the game's lore to give players a clear understanding of who they are fighting for and against. This could be a classic confrontation between the USA and Russia, or fictional sides of the conflict. The game's goal is to show the realities of modern warfare, focusing on the use of drones and nothing else.

notes.title: Enhanced Keyboard and Mouse Control, Bug Fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/a3fa1bc32af867dba50faf39ebbf60f0b9e64654.png[/img]

Furthermore, the extended input option has been abolished, and support for all possible controllers is now enabled by default.

notes.title: Game menu navigation using Xbox joystick
notes.content: In the latest update of "FPV Kamikaze Drone," partial support for the Xbox joystick was added, allowing players to fully control the game menu without resorting to a keyboard and mouse. In addition, minor adjustments were made to the user interface.

notes.title: Setting Up a PlayStation Joystick in Steam
notes.content:
Your PlayStation joystick is not recognized in the game? Simply follow these steps:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/b0e96545e0abb1070316860296c7db718b9ebf4d.png[/img]

Open Steam Overlay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/aa21e5c22c6e17f8b4bb63ba927a38994906a0a5.png[/img]

Go to the controller settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/bbe2d7ec4db0583bf5fc2a91b92cd066687e68b9.png[/img]

Select the "Gamepad" layout. Apply the selected layout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/3cc21f27cfeb631bcdf86595cda46e9dd08c0c49.png[/img]

Return to the game and go to its settings. Now your controller should be detected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/782fe9cd9b28d69e49b0fedb3c2e9a1f4a568d6d.png[/img]

All that remains is to adjust the axes and, if necessary, enable control inversion.
In this way, you can set up your PlayStation joystick for gaming via Steam.

notes.title: New Axis Settings
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/055acbc96e0a0e6bae6ced7b22e0ef72907f5d03.png[/img]

In the advanced input settings, we've added extra axis control options, including inversion, sensitivity adjustment, and dead zone configuration. Reminder: if you're using a non-standard controller, including Playstation, please enable Advanced Input and apply the settings accordingly.

notes.title: Hot Fix: Throttle issue resolved
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/c2eb556b7f6ef147ab0ec7c01a39e1d2037e9f94.jpg[/img]

Now, the 'Reset and Auto-Calibration' button is available in settings. If you have axis problems, use this button to reset all axes and buttons and to perform auto-calibration. Have a pleasant flight!

notes.title: Controller Support for Drone Control
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787011/1ea13f9e0e16129d3172d85793e17f2ff7b6ad5a.png[/img]

At present, our game has limited controller support: full drone control is possible with an Xbox joystick, but navigating the menu requires a keyboard and mouse, as the game is not fully adapted for controller use. To use Playstation joysticks and radio controllers, activate 'advanced input' in the settings and configure the control axes to your preference. By default, it's sufficient to simply enable this option. We are actively working on the ability to navigate menus using joysticks, as well as on fine-tuning input settings such as dead zones, sensitivity, and more, to enhance your gaming experience. We wish you a pleasant flight!
